text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Narita 
Top Road—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that girl... Hehe. Excuse me, Trainer. 
Do you mind if I check on her for a 
second?

Narita Top Road runs under the overpass. 
And who she found there was—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hello! ...Training today too?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Top Road big sis! Yeah, training! I 
worked super hard today too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna run, so watch me! *Zoooom*!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She's actually from the kids' club. 
She told me her grandma lives around here 
and that she came over to visit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"On my days off, I also drop by to visit 
the kids' club, but... hehe. Even when 
they come to play, it turns into training, 
huh?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Whenever we meet here, she always 
begs me to train her. She's just so 
adorable.

A happily laughing girl is running a short 
distance, completely out of breath. Her 
running form is still a bit clumsy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if I used to run just as 
recklessly when I was a kid."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Supported by so many people, taught by my 
coach, and now by you, Trainer... that's 
why I'm standing here today, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It really hits me deep down that I'm 
not alone.

Catching her breath with heavy pants, the 
girl returned with a look of 
accomplishment on her face.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back! You were so fast. I was 
honestly amazed.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Guess what, guess what? When I'm 
here, all the older Umamusume big sisters 
teach me lots of things!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text:
I got advice yesterday... and the day 
before, too! Yup, advice! Um, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Are you training? By yourself? ......

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...... Even if you fail, do not panic. 
Steady your heart... and keep control over 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! Very well!! The divine 
revelation that is myself gracing you 
shall become an irreplaceable treasure to 
you!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, lift your hooves high and let the 
horseshoes gleam! Night may fall, but it 
matters not... For a brilliance akin to 
the sun is right here!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text:
I did what you told me, and I got faster! 
There was stuff that was hard and 
confusing, but... it was so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's how you two feel... All 
right! Then allow me to offer some advice 
of my own!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Giving it your all all the time is 
wonderful, but you should learn to 
identify the exact moments that truly 
count.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"And then, you'll be able to zoom-zoom 
even zoomier than before!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text: Really!? Even more *vroooom*!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And besides that... let's see. Always 
cherish the people who give you advice and 
support you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It will surely become a source of strength 
for your future self.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: Shall we give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text:
I seeee...! Getting cheered on gives you 
energy, huh! Got it! I'll cherish it and 
go WHOOOOSH!!
choice_data_list: And there she goes running off again...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You're plenty full of energy even 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so much for saying 'That's 
exactly right' with your head held high."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I feel like I can be confident in 
myself too. ...Fufu.

Seeing Narita Top Road laugh so happily 
made me feel somehow a little bashful.

I'll tell them: "I'll cheer for you, so 
how about challenging Narita Top Road?"

"I'll cheer for you, so why not try taking 
on Narita Top Road?" I say.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Waah, that's wonderful! Your cheers are 
amazing, Trainer. They just fill you right 
up with energy!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text:
! Yay!! Alright, it's a match! I am 
de-fi-nite-ly gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. With their eyes sparkling like 
that... Alright, I'm heading out too!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ZOOM!!

I watched over the two of them as they 
happily ran through the twilight.
